mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q01.stem: Treatment outlet liquid is clear but analysis is pending. What is appropriate?
options: Keep it on hold until required checks finish
Add unknown waste to dilute it
reasons: Appearance alone does not establish discharge suitability.
Identification and treatment conditions are unknown.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q02.stem: Distinguish bronze and brass from material evidence. Which main additions correspond?

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q03.stem: The entrance prohibits flames; a side passage prohibits entry. What is appropriate?
options: Hide text to make signs uniform
Red always means the same thing
Check prohibited actions and prohibited areas separately
reasons: Read graphics, text and locations together.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q04.stem: A records neutral salt spray and B CASS duration. What is appropriate?
options: Convert by one ratio to outdoor life
Avoid time-only comparison without matching methods and samples
reasons: Do not simply compare different test loads.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q05.stem: Positive ideal resistors 12Ω and 6Ω are parallel. What is their equivalent?
reasons: It is not a simple average.
The product has not been divided by the sum.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q06.stem: Bubbles are attached to a hydrometer. What is appropriate?
options: Use the prescribed method to check stable floating and reading conditions

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q07.stem: Someone says strong electrolyte means concentrated liquid. Which distinction is correct?
options: Dissociation degree and metal ranking are the same quantity

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q08.stem: Further edge removal is proposed to hide peeling. What is appropriate?
options: Identify and check dimensional/coating effects and approved disposition
reasons: This can create thermal or shape defects.
Removing appearance is not restoring quality.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q09.stem: A nondestructive gauge is to measure a different multilayer material. What takes priority?
options: Substrate, coating, layer and calibration-sample compatibility
reasons: This does not replace current-condition checks.
Do not choose methods for convenience.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-practical-q10.stem: A colored item looks red only near a window. What is appropriate?
options: Declare failure only at the window
Compare the color sample under specified light, position and angle
reasons: This is not the specified condition.
That is a separate performance requirement.
